{{Quote|Transponder code confirmed. That's the ''Indupar Nova''.|[[Kett (Corellian)|Kett]]|<ref name="P&P" />}}
The '''''Indupar Nova''''' was a [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] that saw service during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the ''Indupar Nova'' was attacked by the [[Rebel privateer]] [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] ''[[Free Lance]]'' in the [[Ec Pand system/Legends|Ec Pand system]] while it was carrying the [[Noble/Legends|noblewoman]] [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Kalena]] of [[House Indupar]] as a passenger. The corvette was boarded and captured, and it's [[Officer/Legends|officers]] were held aboard the ''Free Lance'' as prisoners-of-war.<ref name="P&P" />

''Free Lance'' [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Urias Xhaxin]] surmised from the ''Indupar Nova''{{'s}} actions when it encountered the [[barricade]] set up by the privateers that the ship had idiots for captain and [[Navigator/Legends|navigator]], but a good [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]].<ref name="P&P" />
